selectedBatteryMovement20261024.sourceFinding: Before fire, loops crew of the selected artillery and issues doMove to actual driver or commander; waits on vehicle distance<120 or death with no finite timeout. After request20..35s, loops same selected vehicle crew for displacement. It does not explicitly issue group move/waypoints. Two seat writes are not a desirable competing-controller model.
selectedBatteryMovement20261024.cbeFinding: CortexArtilleryPosition uses OperationStart empty participant fallback plus CortexGroupMove HOLD; CortexArtilleryScoot uses CortexGroupMove MOVE. Both restrict independent single-platform groups. Current crew/task/session and original-deadline protection exists; selected vehicle movement in mixed groups is not implemented.
selectedBatteryMovement20261024.requiredContribution: Implement selected-platform pre/postfire displacement under one actual current control owner, preserving the original group mission/native tasks and other vehicles/foot actors. Retain finite acknowledgement/progress/deadline, exact original seats/native destination, cancellation/handback and fresh range/HOLD/readiness evidence. Do not copy dual-seat writes, unbounded wait, unsafe random destination or opposing-side command. Do not present whole-group path as mixed-group parity.

positionReadyNativeGoals20261024.finding: READY stopped owner positioning observations once server mission left POSITIONING. Shot rechecked original seats/group HOLD but neither driver current task nor operating-seat native destinations. A newer individual MOVE could leave the same group HOLD and unchanged seats while a queued shot retained stale readiness.
positionReadyNativeGoals20261024.change: First physical READY freezes two finite3D destination points locally. Duplicate READY reports cannot rebase them. Positioned shot preflight and final native issue compare fresh points and require both seats local, effective, simulated, nonplayer/nonremote, unreserved/task-available, MOVE/PATH enabled and no native STOP or external actor control. Existing unpositioned mission admission and serial-consumption/rejection path retained.
positionReadyNativeGoals20261024.deliberateLimit: Do not freeze currentCommand or planningMode: native gun tasks and planning completion can legitimately change those without a new movement destination. Identical native points cannot establish who authored a repeated identical order. No native task is restored or rewritten here.
positionReadyNativeGoals20261024.selectedMovementTrace: Existing DrivingRecoveryCommandState classifies its own recovery/native-return/child journals and cannot grant new artillery authority by constructing a lookalike journal. DrivingMovementAvailable is group-scoped, not selected-platform ownership. OperationRestore intentionally restores owned settings only, not native movement. Replacing CortexGroupMove with doMove alone is insufficient: documented leader arrival reforms the group and subordinate arrival can return to formation. Need explicit selected-platform arrival/hold/return lifecycle and prepared leader/nonleader mixed-group checks, not dual driver/commander writes.
positionReadyNativeGoals20261024.validation: 8 existing focused artillery cases, full1491, SQF validation, HEMTT412 SQF/9 PBO and all build gates plus independent package verification passed. Existing readiness test extended; no new cases. Command/motion behaviour remains unrun.
positionReadyNativeGoals20261024.limits: Fixed two-seat native reads and eligibility calls; no new query loops/workers/deadlines. No physical readiness/repeated fire/false-refusal/handback/performance/parity credit. Selected-battery mixed-group movement remains unimplemented. Audits PAUSED. Unsigned dirty development package includes unrelated existing dirt; review/notes postdate package.
